CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2399 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer (R10-DIAG-REPLAY, branch fix/r10-diag-replay-pr), head acf14d8f2267718203d9dc1b313bc8c3e9f0bc8d. Never send push notifications.
The round-1 `Fix review:` is blocked for two reasons. Read it in full.
(1) carry-missing: the body's `## Forward-carry` text for R10-BRIEFS-FOLD is in the PR body only. Write it into R10-BRIEFS-FOLD's brief with `python3 tools/audit/seat/roster_edit.py append-carry` (pass the text as @file and read it back) ON THE ROSTER BRANCH: fetch `handoff/audit-r10-roster`, commit on its tip, and push it fast-forward to `handoff/audit-r10-roster`. Run `node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs` and read its exit code and error lines. The #2399 branch needs no change for this part.
(2) CodeQL is a real alert: py/clear-text-logging-sensitive-data at tests/harness.py:50 (the R.check FAIL print), most likely reached from str(_secret_drop) at tests/debug_collect.py:1144. Fix it soundly in the code, for example by not putting secret-shaped values into a check's detail, while keeping the check's power: its mutants must still go red. Never dismiss or suppress the alert.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. Toolchain is on PATH. Run heavy jobs in the background with Monitor. Run tests/entities.py with `env -u BASH_ENV`.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from origin/main and follow them exactly. Merge origin/main, never rebase. Re-execute steps 2-8 for (2) and re-take the body in full; answer every red check in `## Red checks`; the forward-carry section names the roster commit.
Return: push code to `handoff/r10-diag-replay` (fast-forward) and the body via tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh to `handoff-body/r10-diag-replay`, plus the roster commit to `handoff/audit-r10-roster`. Push nothing else; do not open, edit, comment on or merge any PR. A fixer writes no delivery row. No host paths in any text. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it. End with CODE=<sha> BODY=<sha> ROSTER=<sha>.
